breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Fluid collection within the pericardial sac, usually due to inflammation.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

curated.category: 慢性复发性炎症性皮肤病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 最常见的慢性剧痒性炎症性皮肤病，本身不直接致死；但剧烈瘙痒导致儿童与成人严重失眠、抓破继发金黄色葡萄球菌/疱疹病毒感染（疱疹性湿疹可致高热重症），并显著增加哮喘、过敏性鼻炎及焦虑抑郁风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 过去只能靠激素药膏反复擦拭，如今度普利尤单抗（IL-4Rα单抗，覆盖6个月以上婴幼儿至成人）、口服JAK1抑制剂（乌帕替尼、阿布昔替尼）及外用非激素靶向药膏均已获批并纳入国家常规药品目录，可安全长效止痒并大幅减少复发。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021未单列直接死因，特应性皮炎是全球疾病负担（DALYs）最高的非致死性皮肤病

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患病人数约1.29亿例（GBD 2021），儿童患病率约10%–20%，成人约2%–8%
epidemiology.prevalence_china: GBD 2021估算中国现患病人数约1,542万例（年新发约217万例），5岁以下儿童患病率最高

non_drug_therapies_zh: 每天足量涂抹无香精保湿霜修复皮肤屏障（“洗澡后3分钟内涂抹润肤剂”，成人每周用量可达200–500克）
避免盲目过度忌口：仅在明确诱发速发或延迟湿疹加重的食物时才回避，切忌长期盲目断奶断肉蛋导致儿童营养不良
穿纯棉宽松衣物，控制室温避免出汗闷热，主动维持治疗（皮损消退后每周2次涂抹非激素药膏预防复发）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 轻度保湿+外用药年费约1,000–3,000元；中重度使用目录内度普利尤单抗或口服JAK1抑制剂年药费约1.5万–3万元人民币

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向IL-13单抗（Lebrikizumab、Tralokinumab）与IL-31受体单抗（Nemolizumab，强效止痒）在国际及中国临床相继推进或获批；2) 国产IL-4Rα单抗（司普奇拜单抗CM310）及外用JAK/AHR调节剂（本维莫德、鲁索替尼乳膏）进一步丰富了中国患者选择。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 停用生物制剂或JAK抑制剂后仍有较高复发倾向，尚未实现“免疫重塑”；2) 约15%–20%患者对单药IL-4Rα阻断应答不佳，或出现结膜炎等副作用；3) 基层家长“恐激素”拒绝规范外用或轻信“纯中药无激素特效膏（实则非法添加超强激素）”现象仍很普遍。

master.definition_en: Congenital mirror movement disorder is a condition in which intentional movements of one side of the body are mirrored by involuntary movements of the other side. For example, when an affected individual makes a fist with the right hand, the left hand makes a similar movement. The mirror movements in this disorder primarily involve the upper limbs, especially the hands and fingers. This pattern of movements is present from infancy or early childhood and usually persists throughout life, without other associated signs and symptoms. Intelligence and lifespan are not affected.

master.definition_en: Mosaic trisomy 9 is a chromosomal abnormality that can affect may parts of the body. In people affected by this condition, some of the body's cells have three copies of chromosome 9 (trisomy), while other cells have the usual two copies of this chromosome. The signs and symptoms vary but may include mild to severe intellectual disability, developmental delay, growth problems (both before and after birth), congenital heart defects, and/or abnormalities of the craniofacial (skull and face) region. Most cases are not inherited; it often occurs sporadically as a random event during the formation of the reproductive cells (egg and sperm) or as the fertilized egg divides. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.

master.name_en: extraskeletal Ewing sarcoma/peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor
master.definition_en: A spectrum of malignant tumors arising from the soft tissues, characterized morphologically by the presence of small round cells. Ewing sarcoma and peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor represent the ends of a spectrum, with Ewing sarcoma lacking evidence of neural differentiation and the markers that characterize the peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Ewing sarcoma and peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor may share cytogenetic abnormalities, proto-oncogene expression, cell culture and immunohistochemical abnormalities. Pain and the presence of a mass are the most common clinical symptoms.

master.definition_en: A precancerous condition characterized by the presence of somatic mutations in bone marrow or peripheral blood cells in individuals who may be cytopenic but do not have morphologic evidence of hematologic neoplasia.
